subject: [PATCH 14/22] mm/page_alloc: count common memory nodes for kswapd recovery

2026-11-14.patch_summary: This patch modifies the behavior of free_frozen_page_commit() to only clear kswapd hopeless state when there is more than one common memory node, rather than any memory node. This change ensures that direct reclaim is triggered even if allocations fall back to another node without triggering it initially. The patch does not alter behavior since all memory is considered common at this point.
